==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Matrim Cauthon]]}}

[[Tylin]] and [[Suroth]] leave the palace to tour Altara so [[Mat]] plots with [[Thom]], [[Juilin]], and [[Beslan]] to escape from [[Ebou Dar]]. He has a challenging task just getting himself, Thom, Juilin and the Redarms away to Luca's travelling show. But he also promised to get [[Teslyn]], [[Joline]] and [[Edesina]] out of the city also and the Seanchan have made it nearly impossible for anyone that can channel to leave the city.

Mat starts by asking Juilin to get him an ''a'dam'', three ''damane'' dresses and one ''sul'dam'' dress. Juilin protests of course that he is not a thief, but agrees since he wants to leave with one of [[Suroth]]'s ''da'covale''.  Tuon continues to stalk Mat but doesn't speak to him. The servants understand what he is about and try to hamper his efforts. Mat continues to receive information that a ''[[gholam]]'' has been killing every night, so he tries to speed up his departure. Beslan plans to start an uprising against the Seanchan as a distraction to help Mat's escape. Unfortunately no one is having luck getting the things they need especially women to impersonate ''sul'dam''. Finally Juilin gets the dresses and the ''a'dam'' but nothing else is ready.
